build_camera_sensors: build camera pose and image sensors from MJCF root and camera configuration mappings
create_camera_pose_sensor: create a CameraPoseSensor from an MJCF camera element to observe position and quaternion
create_camera_image_sensor: create a CameraImageSensor with RGB, depth, or segmentation channels using a CameraConfig
get_sensor_bundle: get a bundle of CameraPoseSensor and CameraImageSensor for a single MJCF camera element
compute_pinhole_intrinsics: compute a 3x4 pinhole camera intrinsic matrix from image shape and vertical field of view
